title: Software Engineer III, Platforms Infrastructure Engineering

cond_0001.intro:
[Company name masked]'s software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to [Company name masked]'s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of [Company name masked] platforms, we make [Company name masked]'s product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Write product or system development code. Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies. Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback. Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 Years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.
2 Years of experience with data structures or algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
Proficiency in code and system health, diagnosis and resolution, and software test engineering.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
2 Years of experience with performance, large scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, and/or debugging.
Experience developing accessible technologies.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
cond_0001.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, please apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong. Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. [Company name masked] is a place where everyone can grow. So, however, you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.
cond_0001.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

cond_0102.intro:
We are looking for a Software Engineer III to join our team.
[Company name masked]'s software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to [Company name masked]'s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of [Company name masked] platforms, we make [Company name masked]'s product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

[Company name masked]'s software engineers work together to build next-generation technologies that shape how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information. Our products handle information at massive scale, extending well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from areas including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design, and mobile — and the list keeps growing.
As a software engineer, you will coordinate with your team on a specific project critical to [Company name masked]'s needs, with opportunities to move across teams and projects as you and the business grow. We need engineers who are versatile, show leadership, and are ready to take on new problems across the full stack as we continue to push technology forward.
Working alongside your peers, you will help manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables, and share in designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and enhancing software solutions.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of [Company name masked] platforms, we make [Company name masked]'s product portfolio possible. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring users have the best and fastest experience possible.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
Collaborate with teammates to write product or system development code.
Participate in design reviews with peers and stakeholders to jointly evaluate and decide among available technologies, or help facilitate those reviews.
Review code developed by other engineers and share feedback to support best practices (e.g., style guidelines, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
Contribute to shared documentation or educational content, and help adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
Work with the team to triage product or system issues, and coordinate on debugging, tracking, and resolving problems by analyzing their sources and impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 Years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.
2 Years of experience with data structures or algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
Proficiency in code and system health, diagnosis and resolution, and software test engineering.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
2 Years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, and/or debugging.
Experience developing accessible technologies.
cond_0153.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0153.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
